title: Gen Active #6 Wildstorm 2001 Gen 13 Anthology Direct Sales

descriptionText:
Gen Active #6 (August 2001), Wildstorm - Gen 13 anthology. Direct sales, $3.95 cover price.

Back cover: Unbreakable Vista Series DVD ad (Bruce Willis, Samuel L. Jackson).
